content.title: Validate: Geist font wire-up in webapp
content.description: Validate the Geist font wire-up. Confirm: (1) the import is present in frontend/src/main.tsx before index.css; (2) font-family with "Geist Variable" + system-ui fallback is set on the body in the @layer base block of frontend/src/index.css; (3) the build passes (cd packages/webapp/frontend && bun run build); (4) run a relevant e2e phase (Phase 1 most likely to care about layout) to confirm no visual assertions break. Report pass/fail with evidence.

content.reason: Blocker issue mqh4glovns transitioned to done

content.content:
Validation: PASS (with one environmental caveat).

Acceptance criteria results:

1. Import order in main.tsx — PASS. Line 3 imports @fontsource-variable/geist/index.css BEFORE line 5 which imports ./index.css. The dependency is declared in frontend package.json (@fontsource-variable/geist ^5.2.9) and installed in node_modules; the package exposes the expected font-family name 'Geist Variable' across 5 unicode subsets (latin, latin-ext, cyrillic, cyrillic-ext, vietnamese).

2. font-family in @layer base of index.css — PASS. Lines 171-172 set font-family: "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif on the html/body selector inside the @layer base block. Matches the requested stack (Geist Variable + system-ui fallback).

3. Production build — PASS. cd packages/webapp/frontend && bun run build completed in ~1.05s. The bundled CSS (dist/assets/index-CjUnE_sg.css, ~59 KB) contains: 5 @font-face declarations, 5 woff2 assets shipped to dist/assets/ (latin 29KB, latin-ext 16KB, cyrillic 15KB, cyrillic-ext 7KB, vietnamese 8KB), and the body rule with the Geist Variable stack plus system-ui fallback. The font is genuinely shipped, not just referenced.

4. Phase 1 E2E — BLOCKED by environment, but not blocking validation. Port 5000 (the frontend webServer port pinned by playwright.config.ts) is occupied by the macOS ControlCenter AirPlay Receiver (PID auto-restarts on kill, cannot be permanently freed without sudo). This matches the known limitation in webapp-validator-gotchas. As a fallback I booted the Vite dev server manually on an alternate port (5002): it started cleanly in ~130ms and the dev-served /src/index.css contains the rule font-family: "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif. Additionally, inspection of phase1-validation.spec.ts shows Phase 1 contains NO font/layout/visual assertions — it covers backend health, page title, brand-link visibility, no JS pageerrors, and the Vite proxy. The Geist wire-up is pure CSS and does not affect any of those assertions, so the original Phase 1 outcomes would not regress from this change.

Overall: Geist font wire-up is complete and correct end-to-end (source -> build -> shipped assets). The only un-run check is Phase 1 E2E, which is blocked by an environment port conflict outside the code, and is also not semantically relevant to the font change.

Note: bundling emits a >500KB chunk-size warning for index-*.js (~551KB), but that is pre-existing and unrelated to the Geist work.
